Copy type ARC struct { // contains filtered or unexported fields } func Get(key interface{}) (interface{}, error) Get a value from cache pool using key if it exists. If not exists and it has LoaderFunc, it will generate the value using you have specified LoaderFunc method returns value. func GetALL(checkExpired bool) map[interface{}]interface{} GetALL returns all key-value pairs in the cache. func GetIFPresent(key interface{}) (interface{}, error) GetIFPresent gets a value from cache pool using key if it exists. If it does not exists key, returns KeyNotFoundError. And send a request which refresh value for specified key if cache object has LoaderFunc. func Has(key interface{}) bool Has checks if key exists in cache func Keys(checkExpired bool) []interface{} Keys returns a slice of the keys in the cache. func Len(checkExpired bool) int Len returns the number of items in the cache. func Purge() Purge is used to completely clear the cache func Remove(key interface{}) bool Remove removes the provided key from the cache. func Set(key, value interface{}) error func SetWithExpire(key, value interface{}, expiration time.Duration) error Set a new key-value pair with an expiration time type AddedFunc Copy type AddedFunc func ( interface {}, interface {}) type Cache Copy type Cache interface { // Set inserts or updates the specified key-value pair. SetWithExpire func(key, value interface{}, expiration time.Duration) error SetWithExpire inserts or updates the specified key-value pair with an expiration time. Get func(key interface{}) (interface{}, error) Get returns the value for the specified key if it is present in the cache. If the key is not present in the cache and the cache has LoaderFunc, invoke the LoaderFunc function and inserts the key-value pair in the cache. If the key is not present in the cache and the cache does not have a LoaderFunc, return KeyNotFoundError. GetIFPresent func(key interface{}) (interface{}, error) GetIFPresent returns the value for the specified key if it is present in the cache. Return KeyNotFoundError if the key is not present. GetALL func(checkExpired bool) map[interface{}]interface{} GetAll returns a map containing all key-value pairs in the cache. Remove func(key interface{}) bool Remove removes the specified key from the cache if the key is present. Returns true if the key was present and the key has been deleted. Purge func() Purge removes all key-value pairs from the cache. Keys func(checkExpired bool) []interface{} Keys returns a slice containing all keys in the cache. Len func(checkExpired bool) int Len returns the number of items in the cache. Has func(key interface{}) bool Has returns true if the key exists in the cache. type CacheBuilder Copy type CacheBuilder struct { // contains filtered or unexported fields } func ARC() *CacheBuilder func AddedFunc(addedFunc AddedFunc) *CacheBuilder func Builder) Build() Cache func Clock(clock Clock) *CacheBuilder func DeserializeFunc(deserializeFunc DeserializeFunc) *CacheBuilder func EvictType(tp string) *CacheBuilder func EvictedFunc(evictedFunc EvictedFunc) *CacheBuilder func Expiration(expiration time.Duration) *CacheBuilder func LFU() *CacheBuilder func LRU() *CacheBuilder func LoaderExpireFunc(loaderExpireFunc LoaderExpireFunc) *CacheBuilder Set a loader function with expiration. loaderExpireFunc: create a new value with this function if cached value is expired. If nil returned instead of time.Duration from loaderExpireFunc than value will never expire. func LoaderFunc(loaderFunc LoaderFunc) *CacheBuilder Set a loader function. loaderFunc: create a new value with this function if cached value is expired. func PurgeVisitorFunc(purgeVisitorFunc PurgeVisitorFunc) *CacheBuilder func SerializeFunc(serializeFunc SerializeFunc) *CacheBuilder func Simple() *CacheBuilder type Clock Copy type Clock interface { Now () time . Duration ) } Methods Clock Advance func(d time.Duration) type Group Group represents a class of work and forms a namespace in which units of work can be executed with duplicate suppression. Copy type Group struct { // contains filtered or unexported fields } func Do(key interface{}, fn func() (interface{}, error), isWait bool) (interface{}, bool, error) Do executes and returns the results of the given function, making sure that only one execution is in-flight for a given key at a time. If a duplicate comes in, the duplicate caller waits for the original to complete and receives the same results. type LFUCache Discards the least frequently used items first. Copy type LFUCache struct { // contains filtered or unexported fields } func Get(key interface{}) (interface{}, error) Get a value from cache pool using key if it exists. If it does not exists key and has LoaderFunc, generate a value using LoaderFunc method returns value. func GetALL(checkExpired bool) map[interface{}]interface{} GetALL returns all key-value pairs in the cache. func GetIFPresent(key interface{}) (interface{}, error) GetIFPresent gets a value from cache pool using key if it exists.
